capabilities: Embed the OpenCode web UI in the right sidebar via iframe
Start the OpenCode server automatically inside WSL when the panel opens
Toggle the panel from the ribbon icon or command palette
Configure port, WSL distribution, executable path, working directory and server password
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat plugin; it specifically embeds the OpenCode web UI and only works on Windows with WSL2.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT or manual release download; an earlier 1.x PTY/xterm.js approach is archived in favor of iframe embedding.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run the OpenCode AI agent against a vault from Windows, where the CLI lives inside WSL.

relations.evidence: Embed OpenCode web UI in the Obsidian sidebar via WSL.

summary: WSL bridge that embeds the OpenCode AI web UI in an Obsidian sidebar panel on Windows.
